newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Moody's confirms Den Danske Bank ratings.
newsitem.headline: Moody's confirms Den Danske Bank ratings.

text.p: U.S. credit rating agency Moody's on Thursday said it confirmed the Aa3/P-1/B ratings of Denmark's Den Danske Bank after its purchase of a large stake in Swedish provincial bank Ostgota Enskilda Bank.
Den Danske Bank has bought 77.2 percent of Ostgota Enskilda this week with the acquisition subject to approval of the Swedish regulatory authorities.
Ostgota Enskilda Bank operates mainly in southern Sweden, which is geographically close to Denmark, and therefore gives Den Danske Bank an opportunity to gain a foothold in that market, Moody's said.

"The acquisition should add a new source of recurring earnings to Den Danske Bank's revenue base and it should not significantly affect the business or financial fundamentals of the banking group," Moody's said in a statement.

Moody's confirmed the following ratings: Aa3 long-term deposit rating, senior debt ratings, counterparty ratings; Prime-1 shortterm deposit ratings, commercial paper rating; A2 subordinated debt ratings; B financial strength rating.
The agency said about $2.5 billion of longterm debt was affected.
